title: OpenAI API adds background mode with 2h/8h windows and token discounts
summary: OpenAI has reportedly added a background mode that moves long-running API requests to asynchronous execution: developers set \`background: true\` and choose a completion window of 2h or 8h via \`background\_options.completion\_window\`, paying token rates 30% and 40% below standard respectively. Leaving the window unset uses a default \`soonest\` mode with no discount. The discounts are described as a public beta on GPT-6.2 Astra, GPT-6.2 Sol, GPT-6.1 Terra and GPT-6 Luna, model names that come only from this secondary Telegram report and are not independently verified. The report also notes that background mode temporarily stores response data even when \`store\` is set to false or zero data retention is enabled.
